C0570.title: POS Machine Cash-Out Scheme for Bank Credit Consumer Loan Fraud and Money Laundering
C0570.summary: Starting in November 2020, a fraud gang 'packaged' people without loan qualifications as high-income individuals to obtain bank personal credit consumer loans. Loan intermediaries Wang Mou, Yu Mou and others used POS machines to fabricate consumer transactions to help cash out the loan funds, took a cut, and transferred the remaining funds back to the fraud gang. Using big-data tracking, prosecutors expanded the case from 183,000 yuan to over 6 million yuan and from 1 suspect to 37. The court sentenced Wang and others to 3 to 6 years for illegal business operation and money laundering; between 2021 and the end of 2024, 52 upstream loan fraud participants were sentenced.

references.title: Full-Chain Crackdown on POS Machine Cash-Out and Loan Fraud
